text.hi: भोला की कहानी आगे बढ़ती है। बाज़ार में दो ठग उसे धोखा देना चाहते हैं। पहले नए शब्द सीखो।
text.hinglish: Bhola ki kahani aage badhti hai. Baazaar mein do thag use dhokha dena chahte hain. Pehle naye shabd seekho.
text.en: Bhola's story goes on. Two thugs in the market want to trick him. First, learn the new words.

steps.meaning: a person who cheats or robs people
steps.example: The thug tried to cheat the old man.

exampleMeaning.hi: ठग ने बूढ़े आदमी को ठगने की कोशिश की।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Thag ne boodhe aadmi ko thagne ki koshish ki.

steps.meaning: to make someone believe something that is not true

exampleMeaning.hi: अपने दोस्तों को कभी धोखा मत दो।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Apne doston ko kabhi dhokha mat do.

steps.meaning: wanting to do something very much
steps.example: The children were eager to go out and play.

exampleMeaning.hi: बच्चे बाहर खेलने जाने के लिए उत्सुक थे।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Bachche baahar khelne jaane ke liye utsuk the.

steps.meaning: a choice you make after thinking
steps.example: Going to bed early was a good decision.

exampleMeaning.hi: जल्दी सोना एक अच्छा फ़ैसला था।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Jaldi sona ek achha faisla tha.

steps.meaning: an agreement to pay money if you are wrong
steps.example: I made a bet with my brother.

exampleMeaning.hi: मैंने अपने भाई के साथ शर्त लगाई।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Maine apne bhai ke saath shart lagaayi.

steps.meaning: a person you do not know
a talk between two or more people
steps.example: We had a long conversation on the phone.

exampleMeaning.hi: हमने फ़ोन पर लंबी बातचीत की।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Humne phone par lambi baatcheet ki.

steps.question: Who are thugs?
options: people who cheat and rob others
steps.answer: people who cheat and rob others
steps.modelAnswer: Thugs are people who cheat and rob others.

modelMeaning.hi: ठग वे लोग होते हैं जो दूसरों को धोखा देकर लूटते हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Thag woh log hote hain jo doosron ko dhokha dekar loot-te hain.

steps.question: Are they always successful?

questionMeaning.hi: क्या वे हमेशा कामयाब होते हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kya woh hamesha kaamyaab hote hain?

options: No, a wise person can beat them.
steps.answer: No, a wise person can beat them.
steps.modelAnswer: No, thugs are not always successful. A wise person like Bhola can beat them.

modelMeaning.hi: नहीं, ठग हमेशा कामयाब नहीं होते। भोला जैसा समझदार इंसान उन्हें हरा सकता है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Nahi, thag hamesha kaamyaab nahi hote. Bhola jaisa samajhdaar insaan unhe hara sakta hai.
